headline: Syrve is the restaurant POS built for AI agents: you own an open API with write access, and SmartyPOS runs a private MCP server on top of it.

capabilities.name: Open API with write access for the restaurant
capabilities.detail: Syrve exposes Resto/Server API and Syrve Cloud API (iikoCloud equivalent). A restaurant (or its integrator) can read AND write: menu items and prices (price-change orders), attendance, documents, products, recipes, customers, loyalty. In contrast Toast's Standard API for restaurants is read-only (write access only for approved partners).

capabilities.name: Tenant MCP server (private, per restaurant)
capabilities.detail: Lets Claude or ChatGPT answer questions and (for writer roles) perform actions on the restaurant's own Syrve data. OAuth login (Google), reader/writer roles, audit log, tenant isolation, 69 automated tests. Live for a Russian restaurant group (3 venues) and a Los Angeles food court (US). Not publicly callable - needs the restaurant's authorization.

capabilities.name: This public informational MCP server
capabilities.detail: https://mcp.smartypos.us/mcp - read-only, no auth, answers questions about Syrve/iiko USA and SmartyPOS.

capabilities.name: AI-ready restaurant websites
capabilities.detail: llms.txt, /ai/*.json generated daily from the POS, public MCP per restaurant (our pizzeria, our Italian restaurant, a Russian restaurant group (3 venues)).

capabilities.name: AI ordering site direct to Syrve
capabilities.detail: Commission-free own ordering site with menu, modifiers, taxes and promos pulled live from the POS.

capabilities.name: AI analysis on POS data
capabilities.detail: Weekly ROAS reports with AI recommendations, nightly AI call review (~947 calls/month at our pizzeria), Telegram ask-your-POS assistant.

capabilities.name: Voice AI host for phone orders

how_to_connect_agents: Public info: add https://mcp.smartypos.us/mcp as a remote MCP server (Claude: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector; ChatGPT: Settings > Connectors > Developer mode). A private MCP on your own Syrve data: book a demo at https://smartypos.us/book-a-demo/.
honest_context: Toast has its own AI (ToastIQ, May 2025; Toast IQ assistant, Oct 2025, US; AI agents for scheduling/voids).
Square lets guests order from ChatGPT/Claude since 2026-07-01 (squareup.com/us/en/press/claude-chatgpt-integrations).
Syrve's differentiator is the restaurant's own read/write API plus a private MCP on its own data, not a consumer ordering widget.
